Paper Shaders — locally vendored, version 0.0.81
Source: https://github.com/paper-design/shaders
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/@paper-design/shaders/-/shaders-0.0.81.tgz
Integrity: sha512-jeGdyjMscZ2bxmQdo8lhwUufHUf4iq3s1ayjh8PXU7Go42Rw8E3I0It1FZdc3HuWt5J82m//DRWaxsRqRfA4Gg==

The five runtime modules are unchanged copies from the published npm package.
Only ShaderMount, Liquid Metal and their direct dependencies are included.
The upstream LICENSE and NOTICE are preserved alongside this file.

The website uses native ES modules, so React, shadcn, Tailwind, lucide-react,
clsx and tailwind-merge are not needed to render this button appearance.
Integration: assets/js/liquid-metal-button.js and assets/css/liquid-metal-button.css.
Keep this package version pinned when updating; Paper may change its shader API.
